registration_scope: Audit plan registered after root executed the source-frozen logical control. This is not preregistration of the producer experiment, new material evidence, or an independent confirmation cohort.
prior_review: Producer source statically read, publicAPI and four world definitions checked; independent reviewer did not import or execute producer. Root supplied the completed result digest; first result leaf/JSON schema inspected to bind adapters. Earlier target risk/cost expectations hand-derived before producer execution.
independence_route: Uniform GF(2) parity row spans plus at most32 feasible action subsets, and reconstruction of each frozen leaf from independently declared binary worlds. No producer import, Bellman recursion, reexecution, model fit or real-source read.
proof_scope: Uniform independent hidden bits conditioned on linear parity observations form an affine-uniform posterior. A target parity is known iff its coefficient lies in the observed row span; otherwise its positive probability is1/2.
For two targets, Bayes mean Brier risk equals unknown-target-count/8. Posterior entropy reduction equals observation rank, not oracle-call count.

In these fixed-cost linear fixtures, risk and future feasible costs depend on action subsets but not observed signs. Hence subset-optimal value and minimum cost equal the adaptive DP optimum. This does not extend automatically to nonlinear/noisy/heterogeneous real discovery.
